svg.title: Grouping: retained occurrences and incorrect pairs
svg.desc: Panels a and b compare all members with one representative. The SCA component-name representative bar is 2 with a 2–4 min–max interval. Panel c shows recorded Terraform false-merge pairs. The panels measure different units.
svg.metadata: All drawn values are copied from validated block-1 rows of K_tables/A4_grouping.csv, SHA-256 3e5286d6fa0758a3f3e0d81aea73af34f39c9a11ca38f1d95ad96fa8c5f048eb. All relevant values are identical across five blocks. Study code is read only, never executed.
